caseNameFull: John Edward McCarty v. United States
summary: Appeal from the Circuit Court of the United States for the Northern District of California.
attorneys: Mr. H. V. Morehouse for appellant; The Attorney General and Mr. Assistant-Attorney General Van Orsdel for. appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction on the authority of Chase v. United States, 155 U. S. 489.
